        ### Question
        Indicate which characteristic of the whiplash direction of the nystagmus is characteristic of an acute peripheral non-positional vestibular syndrome:

        ### Options

opb. With visual fixation, it changes direction when looking to one side or the other.
opc. With visual fixation and in the primary position of the gaze it is vertical downwards pure, without horizontal component.
opd. Both with visual fixation and when canceling it is unidirectional.

### Reasoning Chains per Option:

CHAIN: "Acute peripheral vestibular syndrome" -> "nystagmus characteristics analyzed" -> "nystagmus remains unidirectional with fixation" -> "aligns with option 'opd'" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Acute peripheral vestibular syndrome" -> "nystagmus direction assessed" -> "nystagmus is unidirectional" -> "does not change with fixation" -> "supports option 'opd'" -> 75%
